title: Coldest and Hottest
statement: Given an array of temperatures, return both the lowest and the highest value as [lowest, highest]. Return null for an empty array. Read the array only once.

answerKey.pattern: Single scan tracking the running minimum and maximum
keyPoints: Start both min and max from the first element
Update each of them while visiting every element once
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sort and take both ends: O(n log n)

hints: Two separate passes work, but can one pass track both values?
Keep a running minimum and a running maximum.
Start both from the first element after handling the empty array.
